changelog: 5.9.33 (Build 5933): THE MEGA UPDATE - the biggest RubyOS release yet. Multiple profiles, each with its own color and picture, and your profile color now themes the whole OS. New Rubies economy: earn Rubies every day and spend them on storage plans.

5.9.33: Ruby AI is now built into RubyOS, with a text box that stays on screen, a 200-idea bank (ask her 'give me an idea'), and a self-check that closes the app cleanly if anything is wrong. New Auto Clicker app with a hotkey you can set, and a developer code in Settings that unlocks Developer Gold, infinite Rubies and 1 TB of storage.

5.9.33: All 22 Future Updates ideas are in: home screen widgets, two-player games plus 5 new games, a theme store and the Ruby Store, a PIN lock screen, a notification center, split screen, voice controls, guest mode, custom app icons, Ruby Sync (move your whole RubyOS between devices), and more - plus the Ideas Pack with remappable shortcuts, a command palette, virtual desktops, clipboard history, an on-screen keyboard, the Ruby Help app, encrypted backups, and save slots for every game.
5.9.33: Ruby Clicker gains 'Pay Pay the Buy' - trade Rubies for Ruby Points 1-for-1, from 10 up to a million. Gold is now a developer-only color; everyone gets new Silver and Bronze instead.

5.9.33: Bug fixes: Ruby AI now works when RubyOS is opened straight from the downloaded file, pressing Enter sends her messages again, and a window bug that could close an app you had just reopened is fixed.
